text:
zoe-docs: I opened a tiny PR to harmonize SOC2 audit-log language and fix the Python/Go snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612

alan-legal: quick note: avoid absolutes like 'permanent' or 'forever' publicly. SOC2 reviewers prefer explicit scope + legal-hold exceptions.

diego-eng: also noticed the Go example uses old api shape `ExpireSeconds`. New server expects `RetentionPolicy` map. Proposed Go snippet:
```go
client.CreateAuditLog(ctx, tenantID, CreateAuditLogParams{
  RetentionPolicy: map[string]interface{}{"mode":"ttl","seconds":604800},
  Pseudonymize: true,
})
```

zoe-docs: thanks @diego-eng, I'll swap the Go and Python snippets. @maya-privacy do we have a one-line approved for public docs about legal holds?

maya-privacy: suggestion: "Audit logs are retained per customer-configured settings; Redwood does not retain logs beyond configured retention, except to comply with legal obligations (e.g., legal holds)."

alan-legal: that reads well. prefer 'does not' over 'will not'. Also remove any internal links to the legal playbook; replace with '(contact support)'.

diego-eng: adding a short CLI query example for migration guides:
```
# inspect retention
rctl audit get --tenant t_42 --json
# returns retention_policy object
{"retention_policy":{"mode":"ttl","seconds":604800},"pseudonymize":false}
```

zoe-docs: updated PR text and replaced internal link with support pointer. pushed commit to update examples and the retained wording. CI shows one link-warning for an internal reference I removed.

docs-ci: PR #612 checks: unit-tests passed, link-checker warning (internal link removed), lint passed

alan-legal: approved once CI warning resolved, thanks.

maya-privacy: LGTM. small ask: add a brief line in the examples section showing how to enable pseudonymization in each SDK. customers ask for that a lot.

diego-eng: will add the pseudonymize flag to py/js/go snippets in the PR.

zoe-docs: merging after CI. will cherry-pick to the 2.0 migration doc too. thanks all! :tada:
